info.title: OctoEvidence.Cli
info.description: File-backed knowledge and traceability control plane for a four-role delivery team: cited facts, needs to requirements, stories to platform tasks, briefs, proven changes, and feature documents, operated by agents and reviewed by humans through the CLI, MCP, or a loopback web portal.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Four-role delivery knowledge: register cited facts, trace them into records, stories, and tasks, and generate reviews and feature documents.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Detect the repository and create or repair only its configuration and knowledge manifest.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --knowledge-root
options.description: Knowledge directory for a new setup, relative to the repository or absolute; defaults to knowledge-base.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Optional repository platform override; repeat for cross-platform repositories.

options.name: --source
options.description: Optional developer source-code glob override; repeat for multiple source/test roots.

options.name: --role
options.description: Lifecycle role or friendly alias used to tailor setup and the starter prompt. [default: lifecycle-coordinator]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report detection and planned writes without changing any file. [default: False]

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Validate repository configuration, canonical knowledge, and every declared project.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: agent

commands.name: setup

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace modified OctoEvidence-owned skill and specialist-agent assets. [default: False]

options.name: --role
options.description: Lifecycle role or friendly alias; installs only that specialist agent. [default: lifecycle-coordinator]

options.name: --target
options.description: Agent host assets to install: all, codex, or claude. [default: all]

commands.name: roles

options.name: --explain

commands.name: prompt
commands.description: Create a ready-to-use prompt for one lifecycle role, operating mode, and requested task.

options.name: --role
options.description: Agent role from `octoevidence agent roles`. [default: lifecycle-coordinator]

options.name: --mode
options.description: delivery or knowledge. `knowledge` forbids repository edits, review, change advance, and project mutation. [default: delivery]

options.name: --task
options.description: The concrete work this session must do; included verbatim in the prompt.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Existing lcy_<UUIDv7> the session must operate inside rather than create.

commands.name: id
commands.description: Generate immutable time-ordered UUIDv7 identities; aliases and paths stay mutable metadata.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Generate one or more typed lifecycle identities.

options.name: --count

arguments.name: KIND

commands.name: knowledge

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Install local JSON schemas and migrate canonical $schema references.

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Synchronize packaged schemas into the source and knowledge roots and replace former remote references.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: source
commands.description: Register and refresh authoritative repository files.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Register one source file and bind its current bytes by SHA-256.

options.name: --directory

options.name: --kind

options.name: --title

options.name: --revision

options.name: --actor

commands.description: Re-hash one source and mark every dependent observation stale when its bytes changed.

options.name: --revision

commands.name: list

options.name: --directory

commands.name: observation
commands.description: Record atomic observed, inferred, proposed, or conflicting statements with citations, and delegate their role-aware review queue.

options.name: --classification

options.name: --citation
options.description: Citation in src_<UUIDv7>@<locator> form; repeat for conflicts or corroboration.

options.name: --tag
options.description: Searchable classification tag.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: list
commands.description: List observations, including stale and conflicted statements.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Optional lcy_<UUIDv7> filter.

commands.name: assignment

options.name: --directory

options.name: --directory

options.name: --from-role

commands.name: confirm
commands.description: Re-read a stale or unconfirmed fact against the current source and record that it still holds, keeping its id, its history, and every trace pointing at it.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Required accountable human:<name> asserting the statement survived the change.

options.name: --rationale

commands.name: record

options.name: --lifecycle

options.name: --summary

options.name: --observation

options.name: --directory

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Inspect one source, observation, typed record, or generated document.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: query
commands.description: Answer a question from the fact base by reading the files, with every hit cited and carrying the edges it declares plus the edges pointing at it.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Optional lcy_<UUIDv7> filter.

options.name: --kind
options.description: Record kind; repeat as needed. Naming any kind excludes observations.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Platform; repeat as needed. Records naming no platform are shared and always match.

options.name: --status
options.description: proposed, accepted, rejected, stale, or unconfirmed; repeat as needed.

options.name: --property
options.description: Structured detail as <name> or <name>=<substring>, for example stack or interface=POST. Dotted refinements match their family.

options.name: --relation
options.description: Records carrying this trace relation.

options.name: --traces-to
options.description: Records tracing to this id.

options.name: --text
options.description: Case-insensitive substring of title, summary, property value, or observation statement.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum hits of each kind (1-500). [default: 50]

commands.name: story
commands.description: Suggest and create user stories with one planned change per platform task.

commands.name: suggest
commands.description: Read-only: for each accepted requirement without a story, the components that realise it and so the tasks a story would carry.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: lcy_<UUIDv7> project; defaults to the one project when exactly one exists.

commands.name: waits-for
commands.description: Name what this story waits for before any of its tasks may be deployed: one of its own tasks, usually the backend, or another story in full. Clear it and its platforms wait for nobody.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --on
options.description: One of this story's own tasks (chg_<UUIDv7> or key), or another sto_<UUIDv7> whose every task must be deployed first.

options.name: --clear
options.description: Wait for nothing: every platform runs to the end in parallel. [default: False]

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Why this story ships in this order.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

arguments.name: STORY
arguments.description: The sto_<UUIDv7> whose plan this orders.

commands.name: rebind
commands.description: Bind an unchanged story plan to its requirement's current reviewed content and return the story to proposed for a fresh analyst/architect quorum.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --role
options.description: Role proposing the refreshed binding: business-analyst, software-architect, or lifecycle-coordinator.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor recording the refreshed binding.

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Why the unchanged task plan still applies to the reviewed requirement content.

arguments.name: STORY
arguments.description: The sto_<UUIDv7> whose unchanged plan needs fresh upstream review.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create one proposed sto_* for a requirement and one planned chg_* per platform of each named component. With --supersedes, retire one stale delivered story through explicit same-lineage successor work; no prior approval or QA proof carries forward.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --requirement
options.description: req_<UUIDv7> the story satisfies.

options.name: --title
options.description: Story title, for example 'Create user profile'.

options.name: --user-story
options.description: As a … I want … so that …; defaults to the requirement's.

options.name: --component
options.description: cmp_<UUIDv7> that will carry a task; repeat as needed. One change per platform the component owns.

options.name: --platform
options.description: The platforms this requirement needs work on; repeat as needed. Omit to plan every platform the named components own.

options.name: --supersedes
options.description: Stale delivered sto_<UUIDv7> this fresh story explicitly supersedes. Requires --role and --rationale; the old story and tasks remain immutable history.

options.name: --role
options.description: For --supersedes, the proposing role: business-analyst, software-architect, or lifecycle-coordinator.

options.name: --rationale
options.description: For --supersedes, why revised requirement content needs fresh governed work.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: questions
commands.description: Read-only: the rules this story's platforms implemented that the specification never asked for, open and settled, gathered so they are answered once.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Answer one product question the platforms already answered in code: keep every implementation that matches the decision, reject the rest, record acceptance criteria, and open the changes that follow.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --question
options.description: obs_<UUIDv7> of each open question that is the same question. Repeat as needed; omit to decide every open question on the story at once.

options.name: --confirm
options.description: obs_<UUIDv7> of every implementation that already matches the decision. Repeat as needed; omit to reject every direction.

options.name: --criterion
options.description: The answer, in your own words, added to the story's requirement as an acceptance criterion. At least one is required — it is what stops the next platform guessing at the same thing.

options.name: --amend-all
options.description: Open an amending change for every platform on the story, not only those whose direction was rejected. Use it when a platform that never raised the question does not implement the new criterion either. [default: False]

options.name: --role
options.description: The accountable role deciding the question: business-analyst, software-architect after delegation, or lifecycle-coordinator.

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Why. Required whenever a direction is rejected.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

arguments.name: STORY
arguments.description: The sto_<UUIDv7> whose question this decision answers.

commands.name: delegate
commands.description: Hand a story's open product questions to another role. An unstated rule is sometimes a business question and sometimes an architectural one, and either role may pass it to the other.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --question
options.description: obs_<UUIDv7> to move; repeat as needed. Omit to move every open question on the story.

options.name: --from
options.description: The role handing them over.

options.name: --to
options.description: The role taking them.

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Why this role should decide it instead.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: change
commands.description: Open a change for a ticket key, advance it through its states, attach a ticket key to a generated task, or open a bug against it.

commands.name: open
commands.description: Open one planned chg_* pointed at the requirement it implements and the component that owns it.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --after
options.description: Change this one depends on (ticket key or chg_ id); repeat as needed. Work may start before they land; this change cannot be called implemented until they are non-rejected and deployed. Cycles are refused.

options.name: --key
options.description: Your ticket key, for example ABC-123, if you already have it. The tool never invents one.

options.name: --requirement
options.description: req_<UUIDv7> this change implements.

options.name: --component
options.description: cmp_<UUIDv7> that owns the work.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Needed only when the component owns several platforms.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: advance
commands.description: Move a change to its next state with explicit transition authority: approved/closed (human SA) · implemented/deployed (DEV) · verified (QA).

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Project to look the key up in when several projects use it.

options.name: --to
options.description: approved | implemented | deployed | verified | closed.

options.name: --role
options.description: Required transition role: software-architect for approved/closed; software-developer for implemented/deployed; quality-engineer for verified. The lifecycle coordinator may stand in.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Why, in the actor's own words.

commands.name: rebind-requirement
commands.description: Bind a still-planned standalone change to its requirement's current accepted content. This records no approval; progressed work must be superseded by a fresh change.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Project to look the key up in when several projects use it.

options.name: --role
options.description: Role proposing the refreshed standalone task binding: software-architect or lifecycle-coordinator.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor recording the refreshed binding.

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Why the still-planned standalone work applies to the current requirement content.

commands.name: link
commands.description: Attach the team's ticket key to a change generated from a story.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --key
options.description: Ticket key.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: bug
commands.description: Open a bug as a new planned change in the same story, superseding the change it corrects.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Project to look the key up in when several projects use it.

options.name: --key
options.description: Ticket key for the bug, if you have it.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

arguments.name: CHANGE
arguments.description: The chg_<UUIDv7> or ticket key the bug was found in.

commands.name: amend
commands.description: Open an amendment as a new planned change in the same story, superseding the change the product decided differently about. Not a bug: the work was not wrong.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Project to look the key up in when several projects use it.

options.name: --key
options.description: Ticket key for the amendment, if you have it.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

arguments.name: CHANGE
arguments.description: The chg_<UUIDv7> or ticket key to supersede.

commands.name: reconcile-successors
commands.description: Resolve progressed competing Git branches by creating one fresh planned amendment over the complete leaf set. Carries no prior state, approval, evidence, or QA proof.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --change
options.description: A competing chg_<UUIDv7> leaf reported by doctor; repeat for the complete set.

options.name: --role
options.description: software-architect or lifecycle-coordinator.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Accountable human:<name> making the reconciliation decision.

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Why the competing delivered plans converge into this fresh work.

options.name: --key
options.description: Optional ticket key for the fresh reconciliation task.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Remove a change nobody needs. A change has no rejected state — work nobody wants is deleted, and the plan that named it stops naming it.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Project to look the key up in when several projects use it.

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Why it is no longer needed. Required: the plan will stop naming it, and this is all anyone will have.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: depends
commands.description: Record or remove one task's wait for a single change planned elsewhere. It cannot be deployed until that change is. A whole plan waiting on a whole plan is set on the story with 'story waits-for'.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --on
options.description: The chg_<UUIDv7> or key it waits for.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Project to look the keys up in when several projects use them.

options.name: --remove
options.description: Take the wait back off instead of adding it. [default: False]

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Why, in your own words.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

arguments.name: CHANGE
arguments.description: The chg_<UUIDv7> or key that waits.

commands.name: campaign
commands.description: Start and read the quality engineer's integration, verification, and validation campaigns.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Open one proposed tst_* in the shape its kind requires: the relation that kind must carry, one trace per task it assesses, the platforms those tasks own, and the revision they landed at. Returns what still has to be recorded before a human can accept it.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --kind
options.description: integration, verification, or validation. Only verification moves a change to verified.

options.name: --change
options.description: A task this campaign assesses, by ticket key or chg_<UUIDv7>; repeat for several.

options.name: --story
options.description: sto_<UUIDv7> whose every task this campaign assesses. A cross-platform story is verified by one campaign that saw all of its tasks, or by nothing at all.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Project to look ticket keys up in when several projects use them.

options.name: --title
options.description: Campaign title; derived from its targets when omitted.

options.name: --summary
options.description: What this campaign set out to assess.

options.name: --revision
options.description: The candidate revision QA ran against; defaults to the one every named task landed at.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: list
commands.description: Read-only: every campaign in scope, what it assessed, the checks it recorded, and whatever still stands between it and acceptance.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Optional lcy_<UUIDv7> filter.

options.name: --kind
options.description: integration, verification, or validation.

options.name: --change
options.description: Only campaigns assessing this task, by ticket key or chg_<UUIDv7>.

commands.name: evidence
commands.description: Record one executed check and the artifact that proves it ran, on a change or a test campaign.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Put the artifact where evidence lives, hash the bytes actually written, and record the check and its proof together.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Project to look a ticket key up in when several projects use it.

options.name: --check
options.description: Check name, for example 'unit' or 'deploy-staging'. Becomes 'check.<name>'.

options.name: --command
options.description: What actually ran, for example 'dotnet test'. Defaults to the check name.

options.name: --artifact
options.description: Repository-relative path to the file holding the check's output. One already beneath .octoevidence-evidence/ is recorded where it is; anything else is copied in.

options.name: --as
options.description: File name to give the artifact inside the evidence directory, when its own name is taken.

options.name: --revision
options.description: The exact revision these checks ran against; recorded alongside them when given.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

arguments.name: RECORD
arguments.description: chg_<UUIDv7>, tst_<UUIDv7>, or a change's ticket key.

commands.name: bind-owner
commands.description: Local break-glass migration under OS/repository access: bind ownerless legacy proof to this attached repository after re-hashing every artifact. This records declarations; it does not authenticate identity or origin.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Project to look a ticket key up in when several projects use it.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Locally declared human:<name> taking accountability for the legacy owner assertion; this is not identity authentication.

options.name: --role
options.description: software-architect, or lifecycle-coordinator when explicitly standing in.

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Why this repository is declared the historical evidence owner, in the person's own words.

arguments.name: RECORD
arguments.description: chg_<UUIDv7>, tst_<UUIDv7>, or a change's ticket key.

commands.name: key
commands.description: Attach, rename, or clear the friendly key on a need or a story. This attributed revision reopens review for an accepted record; story labels freeze once a task is approved.

options.name: --directory
